run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the Google Test filter unit test suite to verify test filtering and sharding behavior
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar utility function to set or unset environment variables for subprocess invocations
test_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: test the InvokeWithModifiedEnv utility to run a function with temporary environment variable changes
test_RunWithSharding: test the RunWithSharding utility to split test execution across multiple shards by index and total count
test_RunAndExtractTestList: test the RunAndExtractTestList utility to run a test binary and parse the list of tests executed
